# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Jan 12, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw a critical bug fix in the `contracts-bedrock` package, addressing a compiler restriction for `StorageSetter`. Several new pull requests were opened focusing on infrastructure improvements, feature compatibility, and documentation. New issues were raised concerning L2 support, integration testing, and analysis of zombie accounts on OPM.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Compiler Restriction Alignment
* A bug was fixed in `contracts-bedrock` to add a missing `StorageSetter` setting in the lite profile compiler restrictions, ensuring proper alignment. ([#18715](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18715))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
* **Infrastructure & Upstream Updates:**
    * Upstream `op-rs/kona` to the monorepo. ([#18754](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18754))
    * Multiplex `op-supernode` metrics by `chain_id` label and serve at a single endpoint. ([#18750](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18750))
    * Use blob tip cap provided by blob tip oracle in `op-service`. ([#18745](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18745))
* **Feature & Documentation Enhancements:**
    * Move feature compatibility validation to the `Features` library. ([#18752](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18752))
    * Add a link to the handbook directory in the documentation. ([#18749](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18749))

## CLOSED ISSUES
No issues were closed on Jan 12, 2026.

## NEW ISSUES
* **L2 Support & Integration:**
    * Add Osaka-on-L2 support to `op-reth`. ([#18751](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18751))
    * Integration Testing with Interop for `op-supernode`. ([#18756](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18756))
    * Run acceptance tests against the first Glamsterdam devnet (bal-devnet-1). ([#18755](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18755))
* **System Analysis & Optimization:**
    * Determine if there are zombie accounts on OPM in light of potential EIP-7610 retroactive application. ([#18757](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18757))
    * Multiplex virtual node metrics with labels instead of URL path for `op-supernode`. ([#18746](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18746))
    * Add batcher throttling to OP Reth. ([#18747](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18747))
    * Add safe head DB to Kona. ([#18748](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18748))

## ACTIVE ISSUES
### op-node: single aggregate safe-head advancement FCU message per channel ([#15393](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/15393))
The discussion on this issue continues to highlight the problem of excessive FCU (Forkchoice Updated) calls, particularly when the batcher runs with a considerable `--max-channel-duration`. The latest comment from 0x416e746f6e on Jan 12, 2026, indicates that a previous attempt to fix this issue in a pull request ([#18385](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18385)) was incomplete, and the system still performs an FCU on every safe head update instead of buffering them. Earlier comments from teddyknox and clabby mentioned related merges and implementations in `kona-node` that aimed to address this by sending only one FCU per span batch. The core problem remains that frequent FCU calls, especially with higher network latency, can lead to significant delays, despite being fast in local environments. The conversation also touched upon the `no_tx_pool` flag and its potential use to optimize builder work during these frequent calls.
